title: State the tempfile-shape limit's true direction and pin the alphabet
description: test-skills#16 re-review findings (opum-saga, non-blocking). (1) oracle.py:26-27 and :59-60 call BOTH shape limits conservative/never inflated. The deterministic-name half INFLATES: a deterministic write whose name fits the shape (e.g. tmp12345678, base writes 'a', mutant writes 'b') is dropped, so the mutant reads equivalent and a real difference is hidden - the direction DEC-189 forbids. Restate: the shape cannot distinguish a generated name from a deterministic one of the same shape, so dropping it can hide a same-named deterministic write; accepted because keeping it would break the common generated case. The custom-prefix half is correctly conservative. (2) Pin the alphabet tightening: a deterministic UPPERCASE name (tmpA1B2C3D4) must read observable, so re-adding A-Z goes red. Count stays 79 (strengthen an existing case).

acceptanceCriteria.text: oracle.py states the tempfile-shape limit direction per case: the custom prefix is conservative, the deterministic-name case inflates (a mutant differing from a same-named deterministic write reads equivalent), with the reason it is accepted
The tempfile case pins the generated-name alphabet to [a-z0-9_]: a deterministic uppercase name (tmpA1B2C3D4) reads observable, shown red with A-Z re-added

finalSummary: Corrected the tempfile-shape limit and pinned the alphabet. Delivered in opum-ai/test-skills#18 (squash feaa397). The oracle docstring and the TMPFILE_RE comment had called BOTH shape limits conservative; the deterministic-name half actually INFLATES - a deterministic write that fits the shape is dropped, so a mutant differing from a same-named deterministic write reads equivalent, the direction DEC-189 forbids. Now stated per case: the custom prefix is conservative (kept, so an equivalent mutant reads observable and stays a survivor), and the deterministic name is the inflation case, accepted because keeping it would break the common generated case and the classing is limited to speed-only heuristics. The tempfile case also asserts a deterministic uppercase name (tmpA1B2C3D4) reads observable, so re-adding A-Z to the generated-name alphabet goes red; shown failing with A-Z re-added. Gates: 79 passed, gate PASS with growth 0, CI green.
